summary: Practise project risk scoring, method selection, FMEA, and expected monetary value. Explore the five-day outline and plan your training.
lede: Project risk assessment helps project managers, planners, and risk coordinators evaluate uncertainty affecting project objectives and support decisions. Learners practise selecting methods, analyzing assumptions and causes, calibrating probability-impact scores, and recording response owners, triggers, and residual exposure; exercises also cover FMEA, expected monetary value, sensitivity checks, and decision reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who identify, assess, review, or report uncertainty across project planning and delivery. It suits foundation-level learners who need a repeatable way to connect risk evidence with schedule, cost, scope, and response decisions.
modules: Risk Breakdown Structure and Assumption Analysis
Expected Monetary Value for Option Appraisal
prerequisites: No specialist risk-modelling or programming background is required. Familiarity with project plans, milestones, or cost estimates will help you apply the exercises. Excel access is useful for basic sensitivity worksheets; manual calculation remains possible.
